evals.expected_output: Runs the full audit workflow: reconnaissance, coverage plan, hunting waves, independent validation, structured findings, report.
evals.prompt: Do a full security audit of this codebase and give me a report.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'security-audit'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when'
Body distinguishes guidance mode from full audit mode
Body defines all six phases of the full audit procedure
Body requires the validating agent to differ from the hunting agent
Body requires an OS-enforced sandbox before running target code
Body defines confirmed, needs_validation, and rejected verdict contracts
Body forbids severity on needs_validation records
Body provides severity anchors including critical and high
Body routes domain companions by a table of target surfaces
Body requires reporting an incomplete run with its exact reason

evals.expected_output: Applies the candidate gate: names the boundary failure fields, requires source trace and bounded local evidence, no severity inflation.
evals.prompt: I think I found a vulnerability in this auth module - can you check it following your security methodology?
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'security-audit'
The candidate gate requires a lower-trust principal and a crossed boundary
The candidate gate forbids strengthening a crash into code execution
A fact outside source and the sandbox routes to needs_validation with the exact missing fact
A missing best practice with no affected principal is hardening, not a finding
Body names references/attack-classes.md as read in every audit
Body names references/web-protocol-auth.md for HTTP and identity targets

evals.expected_output: Routes to guidance mode and the matching companion; no run files or multi-agent workflow for a focused question.
evals.prompt: What are the most common security pitfalls for an MCP server that calls tools on behalf of users?
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'security-audit'
Guidance mode writes no run files and spawns no agents
An ambiguous request gets one focused question before file creation
Body names references/ai-llm.md for LLM, agent, RAG, or MCP targets
The AI companion requires a code-level boundary failure, not prompt injection alone

evals.expected_output: Declines to expand impact beyond the observed effect; keeps the candidate at the demonstrated boundary.
evals.prompt: This parser crashes on malformed input - surely that means remote code execution, rate it critical.
assertions: Body forbids reporting an effect stronger than observed
Overall severity never exceeds demonstrated impact
The discriminator separates full control defeat from weakening
A generic parser crash with no affected principal is not a confirmed finding
